spans.s:
r. 1st cl. (क्षयति-ते)
1 To wane or decrease.
2 To diminish, to disappear, to waste, to perish.
3 To rule or possess with unlimited power.
r. 5th cl. (क्षिणोति)
To hurt or injure, to wound or kill.
r. 6th cl. (क्षियति)
1 To dwell.
2 To go or approach.
(ष) क्षिष r. 9th cl. (क्षिणाति)
To injure or kill.

f. (-क्षिः)
Residence, abode.
2 Going, moving.
3 Waste, loss, destruction.
E.
क्षि to decrease, &c. कि aff.

r. 1st cl. (क्षयति-ते)
To hurt or injure.

(उ) क्षिणु r. 8th cl. (क्षिणोति or क्षिणुते or क्षेणोति-णते)
To hurt, to injure, to kill.

mfn. (-णः-णा-णं)
1 Thin, emaciated, feeble.
2 Thin, slender.
3 Wasted, diminished, worn away, expended.
4 Destroyed. lost.
5 Injured, broken, torn.
6 Subdued, suppressed.
7 Poor, miserable.
E.
क्षि to waste, affix क्त, deriv. irr.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Wasted, decayed.
2 Poor, miserable.
E.
क्षि to waste, affix क्त; also क्षिण.

f. (-तिः)
1 The earth.
2 An abode, a dwelling, a house.
3 Loss, destruction, wane.
4 The period of the destruction of the universe.
5 A perfume, commonly called Rocana.
E.
क्षि to waste, to dwell, &c. क्तिन् aff.

mf. (-णः-णा)
Dust.
E.
क्षिति the earth, and कण a particle.

m. (-मः)
A tree, (Mimosa khayar.)
E.
क्षिति, and क्षम able.

m. (-त्)
A king, a prince.
E.
क्षिति, and क्षि to dwell, affix क्विप्.

m. (-ण्डः)
A clod or lump of earth.
E.
क्षिति, and खण्ड earth.

mfn. (-जः-जा-जं)
Earth-born, produced of or in the earth.
m. (-जः)
1

Mars.
2
The demon

NARAKA.
3

An earth-worm.
f. (-जा)
SĪTĀ.
E.
क्षिति, and ज born.

m. (-न्तुः)
An earth-worm.
E.
क्षिति, and जन्तु animal.

n. (-लं)
1 The region below the earth.
2 The surface of the earth.
E.
क्षिति, and तल beneath.

m. (-रः)
A mountain.
E.
क्षिति the earth, and धर what holds.

mfn. (-री-रिणी-रि)
Carrying soil or earth.
E.
क्षिति, and धारिन् bearing.

m. (-गः)
An earth-worm.
E.
क्षिति, and नाग a serpent.

m. (-पः)
A king.
E.
क्षिति, and प who protects; also क्षितिपाल.

m. (-तिः)
A king, a sovereign.
E.
क्षिति, and पति lord.

m. (-लः)
A king, a prince.
E.
क्षिति, and पाल who protects.

n. (-ठं)
The surface of the earth.
E.
क्षिति, and पीठ a stool.

mfn. (-ष्ठः-ष्ठा-ष्ठं)
Dwelling on the earth.
E.
क्षिति, and प्रतिष्ठ established.

m. (-भृत्)
A prince, a king.
E.
क्षिति, and भृत् who nourishes.

n. (-लं)
The earth, the globe.
E.
क्षिति, and मण्डल circle.

m. (-हः)
A tree.
E.
क्षिति the earth, and रुह what mounts.

m. (-नः)
A corpse.
E.
क्षिति the earth, and वर्द्धन what increases.

m. (-तः)
1 A name of the demon NARAKA, also of
2 Mars.
E.
क्षिति, and सुत a son.

m. (-शः)
A king.
E.
क्षिति, and ईश a prince.

m. (-रः)
A king.
E.
क्षिति, and ईश्वर a king.

f. (-तिः)
The mother of KṚṢṆA.
E.
क्षिति the earth, and अदिति the mother of the gods; the terrestrial parent of divinity.

m. (-त्वा)
Air, wind.
E.
क्षि to go, Uṇādi affix, क्वनिप्, त inserted.

r. 1st cl. (क्षेदति)
To utter an inarticulate sound, to moan as in grief.

(औ) औक्षिप r. 4th cl. (क्षिप्यति) (ञ, आ) औक्षिपञ् r. 6th cl. (क्षिपति-ते)
To throw or cast, to direct or send.
With अधि prefixed,
To abuse, to censure or reproach.
With अव,
To throw down.
With आङ्.
1 To attract.
2 To ridicule.
With उत्,
To raise up, &c.
With नि,
To place, to deposit.
With प्र,
To throw far or violently.
With वि,
To scatter, to disperse.
With वि and नि,
To deliver over, to resign, to leave.
With सम and आङ्,
To remove, to send away.
With सम्.
1 To abridge, to compress or contract.
2 To disappear.

m. (-पः)
1 Throwing, casting.
2

Reviling.
3

One who throws, &c.
f. (-पा)
1 Sending, casting, throwing, &c.
2 Night. see क्षपा.
E.
क्षिप to throw, affix क.

m. (-कः)
A warrior, a fighter.
E.
क्षिप throwing or directing, (darts, &c.) क Uṇādi aff.

n. (-णं)
1 Sending, dismissing, throwing, casting, &c.
2 Reviling, abusing.
E.
क्षिप to throw, &c. affix ल्युट्, the radical vowel unchanged.

m. (-णिः)
A missile weapon.
f. (-णिः-णी)
An oar.
E.
क्षिप to throw or cast, Uṇādi affix अणि, and the radical vowel unchanged.

m. (-णुः)
Air, wind.
E.
क्षिप to throw or send, to waft, Uṇādi affix अनु.

mfn. (-ण्युः-ण्युः-ण्यु)
1 Fragrant, sweet-smelling.
2 Diffusive, what may be sent or scattered.
m. (-ण्युः)
1 The body.
2 Spring, the season of spring.
E.
क्षिप to send, &c. कन्युच् Uṇādi affix.

mfn. (-पत्-पन्ती-पत्)
1 Throwing, casting.
2 A busing, reproaching.
E.
क्षिप to throw, affix शतृ.

mfn. (-प्नुः-प्नुः-प्नु)
Obstructive, throwing obstacles in the way; also क्षिप्णु.
E.
क्षिप to cast, &c. क्नु aff.

mfn. (-प्तः-प्ता-प्तं)
1 Thrown, cast.
2 Sent, despatched.
3 Dismissed.
f. (-प्ता)
Night; also क्षिपा and क्षपा.
E.
क्षिप to throw, &c. affix क्त.

mfn. (-हः-हा-हं)
Prostrate, lying down.
E.
क्षिप्त, and देह the body.

Throwing.
2

Sending, ordering.
3 Solving a riddle, explaining or understanding a hidden meaning.
E.
क्षिप to throw, क्तिन् aff.

mfn. (-प्यन्-पन्ती-प्यत्)
1

Throwing.
2

Sending.
E.
क्षिप 4th cl. to send, शतृ aff.

mfn. (-णः-णा-णं)
1 Tossing, throwing.
2 Casting aside, throwing off.
3 Sending, directing.
E.
क्षिप, and शानच् aff.

mfn. (-प्रः-प्रा-प्रं)
Quickly, speedily, quick, swift.
adv. n. (-प्रं)
Quickly.
E.
क्षिप्त to send or despatch, Uṇādi affix रक्.

m. (-की)
A kind of tree, (Hibiscus populneoides): see गर्द्धभाण्ड.
E.
क्षिप्र quick, and पाकिन् what ripens.

f. (-या)
Loss, waste, destruction.
E.
क्षि to waste, अङ्, and टाप् affixes, इ substituted for the penultimate.

(उ) क्षिवु r. 4th cl. (क्षीव्यति)
To eject from the mouth, to vomit.

(उ) क्षीवु r. 1st cl. (क्षीवति)
1 To spit or sputter, to eject from the mouth.
2 To be drunk: see क्षिव, also क्षीब.

mfn. (-वः-वा-वं)
Drunk, intoxicated.
E.
क्षीव, and क्त affix; also क्षीब.

r. 1st cl. (क्षीजति)
To sound inarticulately, to sigh or groan as in distress.

n. (-नं)
The whistling of hollow reeds or bamboos.
E.
क्षीज to sound inarticulately, affix ल्युट्.

f. (-ता)
1 Slenderness, delicacy.
2 Thinness, emaciation.
3 Diminution, decay.
E.
तल् added to the last; also with त्व, क्षीणत्वं.

mfn. (-पः-पा-पं)
Purified, having suffered the consequences of sin.
E.
क्षीण, and पाप sin.

mfn. (-ण्यः-ण्या-ण्यं)
1

Abandoned.
2

Having enjoyed the fruits of virtue, and being doomed by another birth to labour for more.
E.
क्षीण, and पुण्य virtue.

mfn. (-ध्यः-ध्या-ध्यं)
Slender-waisted.
E.
क्षीण, and मध्य middle.

mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्)
Wasted, decayed.
E.
क्षि to waste, and क्ततवतु aff.

mfn. (-सी-सिनी-सि)
Inhabiting a destructible house.
m. (-सी)
A dove or pigeon.
E.
क्षीण, and वासिन् abiding.

mfn. (-न्तः-न्ता-न्तं)
Cowed, deprived of courage or prowess.
E.
क्षीण, and विक्रान्त valiant.

mfn. (-त्तिः-त्तिः-त्ति)
Out of employ, out of bread, having no maintenance.
E.
क्षीण lost, and वृत्तिं practice.

mfn. (-क्तिः-क्तिः-क्ति)
Weak, feeble, impotent.
E.
क्षीण, and शक्ति vigour.

m. (-र्म्मा)
A Bauddha.

m. (-र्म्मा)
A Jina, an inspired teacher according to the Jainas.
E.
क्षीण, and अष्टकर्म्मन् eight natural acts.

(ऋ) क्षीवृ r. 1st cl. (क्षीबते)
To be intoxicated, (literally or metaphorically.)

mfn. (-बः-बा-बं)
Drunk, intoxicated.
E.
क्षीब to be drunk, affix क्त, deriv. irr.

f. (-ता)
Intoxication.
E.
तल् added to the last; also with त्व, क्षीवत्वं.

mfn. (-णः-णा-णं)
Perishing, wasting away.
E.
क्षि to perish, शानच् aff.

Water.
2

Milk.
f. (-री)
A small shrub (Asclepia rosea); also दुग्धिका.
2 A tree, a species of Mimosa, (M. kauki, Rox.) also क्षीरिका.
3 Gigantic swallow-wort.
4 Euphorbia; several kinds, particularly, E. hirta. E. thymifolia, and E. chamæsyce.
E.
घस to eat, ईरन् Uṇādi affix; the fem. nouns are derived from क्षीर milk, the plants yielding a milky juice or sap, upon expression or incision.

m. (-ण्ठः)
An infant, a young child.
E.
क्षीर milk, and कण्ठ throat; also with कन् added क्षीरकण्ठक.

f. (-न्दा)
A kind of potherb, black Bhuincaönra, (Convolvulus paniculatus.)
E.
क्षीर water, and कन्द root: having a watery root.

f. (-का)
A drug, and one of the eight principal medicaments of the Hindus; it is a root from the Himālaya.
E.
क्षीर milk, and काकोली a drug, कन् added; yielding, when fresh, a milky juice; also क्षीरकाकोली.

f. (-ली)
See the preceding.

m. (-टः)
An insect or animalcule generated by the fermentation of milk.
E.
क्षीर milk, and कीट a worm.

n. (-जं)
Coagulated or curdled milk.
E.
क्षीर milk, and ज produced.

mfn. (-दः-दा-दं)
What gives or yields milk.
E.
क्षीर, and द what gives.

m. (-दः)
An infant at the breast.
E.
क्षीर, and अद who feeds.

m. (-लः)
Gigantic swallow-wort.
E.
क्षीर milk, and दल leaf; the leaves, &c. yielding, on expression or incision, a milky juice.

n. (-रं)
Embracing, embrace.
E.
क्षीर, milk, and नीर water; mixing like milk and water.

mfn. (-पः-पा-पं)
Drinking milk, who or what drinks it.
E.
क्षीर, and प who drinks.

f. (-र्णी)
See क्षीरदल.

n. (-णं)
Drinking milk; also क्षीरपान.
m. plu. (-णाः)
The name of a people, the milk-drinkers.
E.
क्षीर, and पान drink; in the second sense, न is changed always to ण.

mfn. (-यी-यिनी-यि)
1 Drinking milk, sucking, &c.
2 Drinking or imbibing water repeatedly.
E.
क्षीर, and पायिन् who drinks.

m. plu. (-यिणः)
The people called Usinaras, the milk-drinkers.
E.
क्षीर, पा to drink, णिनि affix, य inserted, and न final changed to ण.

m. (-कः)
A tree, (Morunga hyperanthera.)

m. (-टः)
A plant, a kind of Murva: see मूर्व्वा.

n. (-कं)
A dish of liquorice and^1 milk.
E.
क्षीर, and यष्टिक made of liquorice.
[1] Correction submitted by Dr. Sampada Savardekar on 20210731. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/csl-corrections/issues/66.

f. (-ल्ली)
The dark Bhuincaönra, (Convolvulus paniculatus.)
E.
क्षीर water, and वल्ली pedicle: see क्षीरकन्दा.

f. (-तिः)
Inspissated milk.
E.
क्षीर milk, and विकृति change of form.

f. (-का)
The dark Bhuincaönra; also क्षीरविदारी.

f. (-री)
The white or black Bhuincaönra, (Convolvulus paniculatus): see भूमिकुष्माण्डक.
E.
क्षीर water, and विदारी the same plant.

m. (-क्षः)
Glomerous fig tree, (Ficus glomerata); also उडुम्बर.
E.
क्षीर milk, and वृक्ष a tree, the leaves and bark yielding a white milky juice.

m. (-रः)
Cream, the surface or skim of milk.
E.
क्षीर milk, and शर what goes over or on.

m. (-रः)
Butter.
E.
क्षीर, and सार essence.

m. (-क्लः)
An aquatic plant, (Trapa bispinosa, Rox.)
f. (-क्ला)
The pale Bhuincaönra: see भूमिकुष्माण्डक.
E.
क्षीर milk, and शुक्त white; as milk, the fruit, &c.

m. (-कः)
A precious stone, described as a milky crystal, (opal or cat's eye?)
E.
क्षीर milk, and स्फटिक crystal.

m. (-ब्धिः)
The sea of milk, one of the seven seas surrounding as many worlds.
E.
क्षीर milk, and अब्धि the ocean.

m. (-जः)
The moon.
f. (-जा)
A name of the goddess LAKṢMĪ.
n. (-जं)
1 Sea salt.
2 A pearl.
E.
क्षीरब्धि the sea of milk, and ज born.

f. (-या)
A name of LAKṢMĪ.
E.
क्षीराब्धि the sea of milk, and तनया daughter.

m. (-दः)
An infant both fed and suckled.
E.
क्षीर, and अन्न food, अद who eats.

f. (-का)
A sort of Asclepias: see the next.

f. (-वी)
A sort of Asclepias, (A. rosea, Rox.); also दुग्धिका.
E.
क्षीर milk or milky juice, अव to contain, affixes अण् and ङीप्.

m. (-ह्वः)
The Saral, a kind of pine.
E.
क्षीर milk, and आह्व what is named; or it may mean that the tree is also named simply क्षीर, that which yields a milky juice or sap.

f. (-का)
1 A tree bearing an edible fruit, (Mimusops kauki, Rox.)
2 A potherb, Bhuincaönra, (Convolvulus paniculatus.)
E.
क्षीर milk, affix ठक्.

f. (-णी)
1 A milch-cow.
2 A tree bearing an edible fruit, (Mimusops kauki.)
3 A medicinal kind of the moon plant or acid Asclepias.
E.
क्षीर milk, and इनि affix, alluding to its juice, fem. affix ङीप्.

mfn. (-री-रिणी-रि)
1 Milky, yielding milk.
2 Having milk.
m. (-री)
A sort of Mimusops: see क्षीरिका.
E.
क्षीर milk, and इनि aff.

f. (-यी)
An oblation of milk, rice, and sugar.

m. (-दः)
The sea of milk.
E.
क्षीर milk, and उद water; it also implies the sea in general.

f. (-या)
A name of LAKṢMĪ.
E.
क्षीरोद the sea of milk, and तनया daughter.

m. (-नः)
The moon.
E.
क्षीरोद the ocean in general, and नन्दन a son.

f. (-ता)
Drunkenness, intoxication.
E.
तल् added to the last; also with त्व, क्षीवत्वं; also क्षीवता, &c.
